description: Heavy monsoon rainfall on August 8, 2023 caused river flooding and inundation in Bhaktapur. Reported affected locations included Hanuman Ghat, Ram Mandir, Shanti Niketan School, and Siddhi Memorial Women and Children Hospital. DHM recorded 77.1 mm of rainfall at Bhaktapur and 100.4 mm at Changu Narayan on August 8. Event impacts were documented by The Kathmandu Post: https://kathmandupost.com/bhaktapur/2023/08/08/heavy-downpour-inundates-bhaktapur-settlements. Sponsor photographs remain pending access and verification.
evidenceSource: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal; The Kathmandu Post

Sponsor-verified flood-related observation at the Godawari-Hanumante river confluence on July 6, 2024. Video evidence documents heavy rainfall conditions in the area. River overflow, property damage, and flood impacts have not been independently confirmed.

Flooding documented at Kapan, Kathmandu, on July 12, 2024, in sponsor observation SPONSOR-018. A publicly accessible video titled 'Flood at Kapan Kathmandu' provides supporting evidence. Specific damage and flood extent have not been independently verified.

A flash flood was reported in Samakhushi, Kathmandu, on July 24, 2023. Onlinekhabar reported that a child was swept away and remained missing at the time of publication. Associated sponsor observation SPONSOR-004 was corrected to July 24, 2023 based on the article. The original sponsor spreadsheet recorded July 24, 2024.

Nepal Live reported on September 4, 2024, that the Bishnumati River in Kathmandu had exceeded its danger-level threshold and was continuing to rise. The Department of Hydrology and Meteorology urged residents and travelers near the river to exercise caution. Sponsor observation SPONSOR-005 identifies Chamati on September 6, 2024, but the article does not independently confirm flooding at that location or on that date.
evidenceSource: Nepal Live; DHM warning reported by Rastriya Samachar Samiti; SPONSOR-005
